title: astragalus phacinus
intro: Astragalus phacinus, commonly known as Milk Vetch, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus phacinus include modulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
